digest.component_or_area: CI/CD infrastructure — Ubuntu test job optimization
propositions: YAML parsing in 1,440-iteration bridge-cadence loop is redundant; hoisting schedule load once outside comprehension reduces Ubuntu occupancy by 5.70 runner-minutes per run while preserving exhaustive minute-uniform proof

render_unit existential check runs all 232 Pandoc subprocesses to assert only eligible>0 and changed>0; short-circuiting to one subprocess with witness detection saves 7.85s without reducing assertion strength

Pandoc hardening legacy oracle duplicates real-subprocess work on 884 units while coupled to live convert; replacing only legacy side with immutable expected outputs saves 18.80s per run while keeping all product conversions live
AST provenance fixture setup iteratively rediscovers caller and parent relationships 9.54M times; building indices once per process saves 46s setup time while preserving all 24 guard tuples

Static complexity-lock policy invocation duplicated across all three Ubuntu matrix cells and macOS; moving to lint job and deleting four duplicates saves 2.57 runner-minutes per run with unchanged coverage
Live Jira DC suite already excluded from Verified hot path via not external selector; moving provides zero occupancy benefit
